fusions.name: Gecko Clutch
fusions.desc: Clamps the target in clinging toes and strikes with your weapon in a blow that deals 12 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Let Go
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 20% health. Grabs it from up to 6 tiles away with a blow that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and it moves 40% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fingers Grown Back
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Clinging Hold
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, 10% of the damage you deal heals you for the next 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
